applyTo: "docs/diagrams/**/*.mmd,docs/diagrams/**/*.html"
---
# Diagram instructions

Keep diagrams human-first and agent-readable.

- Use stable diagram IDs and explicit status.
- Labels must be understandable without color.
- Keep Mermaid source canonical; HTML/SVG/PNG are presentation outputs.
- Every diagram must name its audience and canonical source documents in comments or adjacent documentation.
- Do not introduce product scope that is absent from the canonical product/status documents.
- For development diagrams, represent ownership boundaries, shared contracts, validation gates, and failure routing explicitly.
- Prefer one bounded question per diagram; do not turn diagrams into dense architecture inventories.
